- Each output value is a dot product between one row and one column.
- Example:
  A = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
  B = [[5, 6], [7, 8]]
  C[1,1] = (1×5) + (2×7) = 19
  C[1,2] = (1×6) + (2×8) = 22
  C[2,1] = (3×5) + (4×7) = 43
  C[2,2] = (3×6) + (4×8) = 50
  Therefore C = [[19, 22], [43, 50]].
